title: Gold as a safe haven after equity shock days

rule.shock: index close-to-close return < -2 x sd of the 20 returns before the day
rule.entry: gold's next folded UTC daily open
rule.exits: close of day 1 (T1) or day 5 (T2, T3)
rule.costs: $0.3 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long

tests.what: nas100 shock, gold held 5 days (replication market)
